compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: At Rephidim the people contend for water; the LORD stands before Moses on the rock at Horeb, and water comes when Moses strikes it before the elders.
observations.label: Water comes from the rock at Horeb

observations.body: Water comes from the rock at Horeb belongs to approach to mountain in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 17:1–7 supplies antecedent evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Before the assembly

observations.body: Horeb antecedents and the approach to Sinai prepare the Event without turning every wilderness scene into the public assembly.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 17:1–7 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Water comes from the rock at Horeb prepares for the mountain encounter, but this passage does not yet contain the public covenant assembly.
payload.title: Water comes from the rock at Horeb
